note: This file is written to disk before training begins and before the test split is read. The figures this run reports are therefore the figures of one pre-committed budget, not the best of several attempts.
early_stopping_signal: validation loss on a slice of the TRAINING split
checkpoint_selection: lowest validation loss; never test performance
test_read_when: after training has finished and the checkpoint is chosen
learning_rate_note: committed value, deliberately not tuned alongside the budget
schedule_spans: the epoch cap, not the epoch reached
provenance: PROVENANCE: annotator single, non-clinician, the paper's author; validated_by NONE; none computed; there is no second annotator. These labels are NOT clinical ground truth.
